limits: A prediction; balanced reactions map best.
bio.jane/contract.noReading: The answer is the atom-mapped reaction and the model's confidence, which the outputs carry; the Chemistry panel colors atoms by it and writes no reading over it.
bio.jane/contract.question: Which reactant atom does each product atom come from?

description: Predict which reactant atom each product atom came from (atom-to-atom mapping) with RXNMapper (Schwaller et al., Sci. Adv. 2021), the most accurate mapper in Lin et al.'s 2022 benchmark of 1,851 curated reactions. Agents join the reactants, each compound is canonicalised and each side sorted before mapping, as RXNMapper does. Returns the reaction SMILES with atom maps and a confidence (the product of each product atom's attention score). A prediction, not a measurement.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

reaction.description: reaction SMILES, reactants>agents>products; existing atom maps are ignored.

name: map_reaction_atoms

confidence.description: the product of the per-atom confidences, 0 to 1

mapped.description: the canonicalised reaction SMILES with atom maps
